stability: Labels and basenames are stable API. speaker-map and face-map are CONDITIONAL: an absent source makes its map ABSENT (not empty) — three-state semantics. Anything not listed here (_plan/ internals) may change without notice.

persons.description: THE product: resolved person entities with types, names (only from independent naming mechanisms — never co-occurrence alone), per-binding evidence, critic vetoes, unresolved residue, and the provenance pin naming the exact sibling workflow_ids the binding is valid against.

critic_review.reason: self-id in the quotes names a different person than the bound face's registry name

persons.notes: Person types: on_camera_speaker | voice_only | silent_face | depicted_only | uncertain (depicted_only = every face track majority-inside displayed media — photo/monitor/file footage; the name may be true, the presence is not physical). name=null with non-empty aliases means the pipeline ABSTAINED (conflict or critic veto) — a wrong name is worse than none. character_name is additive and present only when a credits card paired this actor with a character (kind:character pairing, mechanism credits_cast) — name stays the actor. bindings[] holds PROPOSED pairings the evidence could not confirm; consumers must not treat them as facts. appearances is the person's presence timeline and appearances_basis says what carried it: `face` (member clusters' screen spans) or `speech` (merged speaker turn spans — the honest degrade on a faceless run). class1 is the hierarchical tier-one record: the programme-carrying voices and faces (each >= 4% of total speech / screen time), matched one-to-one in two angles: eliminations first (what it is NOT: F0-x-gender contradiction, zero co-presence — struck pairs carry an `eliminated` reason), then assertion evidence (what it IS: onset following — the edit cutting to the speaker at turn starts — presence-lift, solo cutaways, name joins). A match's `tier` says which round made it: 1 = the programme-carrying heads, 2 = the same machinery over the residue (smaller voices vs unmatched named faces, same confident bar). The matcher is the ONE binding engine: co-occurrence emits proposals and the narrator classification only, never confirms; matches appear in the persons' evidence as mechanism class1_assignment, and every unmatched class-1 voice carries a recorded abstention with its top candidates (a lead is never silently unbound). A class-1 person whose merged cluster collected other names keeps the sole registry name; the rest demote to aliases (mechanism class1_name_precedence). A class-1-matched person with NO registry name takes a DOMINANT repeated attached name (mechanism dominant_name, the vocative votes+lead bars): a host's chyron repeats across the programme, a guest's shows once; a genuine two-way repeat abstains. critic_review is the tooth-2 LLM reviewer's suspicion list (REPORT-ONLY — it never renames or demotes): per-flag {person_id, verdict: suspect, suspect_field: name|binding|character|type, conflicts: [cited evidence/quote ids], reason}; the same flag rides the flagged person's evidence with action flag_only. Reviewed persons are SUSPICION-ONLY (abstained names, mixed-voice clusters, coherence repairs, tooth-1 vetoes, speech-inferred characters) — a flag means the machine already doubts this person; start reviews there.

speaker-map.description: Flat remap table SPEAKER_ID -> {person_id, name, type}, pinned to the diarization run it was computed from. Only valid joined to THAT run's transcript — a diarization re-run renumbers its clusters.
speaker-map.notes: ABSENT when the run had no speech_diarization_s3uri input (not assessed, not empty).

face-map.description: Flat remap table face person_id -> {person_id, name, type}, pinned to the face-recognition run it was computed from.
face-map.notes: ABSENT when the run had no face_recognition_s3uri input (not assessed, not empty).

credits.description: CONDITIONAL — present only when this run performed a credits read (frame-inspection is internal; this workflow is the only way to order one). The witness product VERBATIM: card text per nondiegetic block, cards in display order with programme-second timestamps — evidence only; which cards deserve voice is the consumer's judgment (audio-description reads it for closing-credits narration).

usage.description: Run cost record. P0 binds from free evidence — zero model spend, stated explicitly (cost_is_complete discipline).
